overall_status: UNTESTED: (B2 migration of partial match state) the ownership boundary (Funcdata::opHeritage -> one Heritage::heritage pass per call, three consecutive calls on the same &mut Funcdata driving pass 0->1->2->3) byte-matches the locked oracle on all three cases, including the full op-list/Varnode-bank state projection of register_free_promote (input promotion, def-use rewiring, consumed-free deletion); the MULTIEQUAL self-reference cycle completes without hang on both sides; Heritage no longer stores or upgrades any Weak<RwLock<Funcdata>> and no nested lock path exists. NOT claimed: production ActionHeritage still uses the direct recipe (HERITAGE-DRIVER-SWITCH), placeMultiequals/rename algorithm equivalence (HERITAGE-ADT-RENAME-0001), guardCalls/discovery (HERITAGE-CALLGUARD-0001)
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; register delay=0, stack delay=1
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the production boundary Funcdata::opHeritage (the funcdata.hh:462 inline wrapper) three consecutive times on the same Funcdata; no Action tree, no C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata built through production APIs (newOp/opSetOpcode/opSetInput/opSetOutput/newUniqueOut/newConstant/newVarnode/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/addEdge); the startProcessing steps a synthetic graph can reach are applied on both sides: structureLoops+calcForwardDominator (Rugra: BlockGraph::build_dom_tree) and heritage.buildInfoList (funcdata.cc:166). Two separate size-4 constants and one free Varnode per read mirror the raw-p-code single-descendant invariants (opSetInput constant clone, addDescend free check)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: the pass counter after each of the three boundary calls (C++ public getHeritagePass / Rust num_heritage_passes); for empty_entry and register_free_promote the complete projection: op count, op list in PcodeOpBank SeqNum order as name.OPCODE(input descriptors), Varnode count, and the sorted Varnode descriptor multiset (C<size>/R<off>:<I|W|F>/U<size>:<I|W|F>); for phi_cycle_selfref the no-hang witness completed=1. The Rust comparand additionally asserts (abort on violation, before printing) the internals Ghidra cannot print because they live in the unlabeled default-private region: ctor/clear maxdepth==-1, exactly one ADT rebuild (maxdepth constant across the three passes: 1/2/4 per case), and the persistent globaldisjoint entry count (0/3/3 per case) surviving every mem::take round-trip
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, or membership normalization; absolute unique-space offsets are not printed because allocation bases differ between the implementations; descriptors carry space class, size or offset, and def-use class

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: empty_entry: one entry block, no IR; three boundary calls each increment pass exactly once and leave the banks empty

register_free_promote: two-block chain; two free reads of register 0x30 (one per reader, raw-p-code shape), a write at 0x30, and two unread unique writes; canonical rename promotes one input, rewires the second reader onto the write, deletes both consumed frees; later passes are inert (prev==2 heritage-known skip)

phi_cycle_selfref: b0->b1->b2->b1 back edge plus b2->b3; MULTIEQUAL m output at register 0x28 read by INT_ADD r in b2 whose output feeds m slot 1 (loop-carried def-use cycle m_out -> r -> t3 -> m, cover-fixture slot2 topology); all three boundary calls return (no hang)

observation_schema.format: Four fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus three case records
observation_schema.state: pass counter sequence; op count; op list (SeqNum order, name.OPCODE + per-slot input descriptors); Varnode count and sorted descriptor multiset; completed flag
observation_schema.graph: def-use class per op input slot (input/written/free/constant), Varnode space class and def-use class multiset

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-heritage-ownership-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Ghidra's Funcdata/Heritage state members live in an unlabeled default-private access region, so no preprocessor shim can print them; the C++ side observes only public APIs (getHeritagePass, beginOpAll, beginLoc). The single production startProcessing step a synthetic graph cannot reach otherwise (heritage.buildInfoList, funcdata.cc:166) is applied through a fixture-local layout mirror of the locked-oracle Funcdata member sequence (funcdata.hh:57-95) whose layout is pinned to the verified oracle commit; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/heritage.rs and src/funcdata.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs both fixtures under a 300s timeout (the no-hang witness), compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again

coverage.ownership_bridge_single_pass_per_call: MATCH: one opHeritage boundary call performs exactly one Heritage::heritage pass; three consecutive calls on the same Funcdata drive pass 0->1->2->3 on both sides
coverage.no_lock_reentry: MATCH (structural, HERITAGE-OWNERSHIP-0001): Heritage stores no Funcdata handle; the pass threads one &mut Funcdata; funcdata.rs set_self_ref no longer feeds heritage; the pre-refactor nominal driver's double write-lock acquisition is deleted; the phi-cycle case completes under timeout where the old path self-deadlocked
coverage.empty_entry_ir_inert: MATCH: no ops/varnodes; banks stay empty across all three passes
coverage.register_free_promote_full_projection: MATCH: op list d1.INT_ADD(R30:I,C4);w2.COPY(C8);r1.INT_OR(R30:W,C4) and Varnode multiset C4,C4,C8,R30:I,R30:W,U8:W,U8:W after three passes — canonical input promotion, def-use rewiring, and consumed-free deletion identical to the oracle
coverage.later_pass_inertness: MATCH: pass 2/3 leave the projection unchanged (prev==2 heritage-known skip in the per-space scan; stack delay=1 clears call placeholders at pass 2 with no calls)
coverage.adt_rebuild_sentinel: MATCH (Rust-asserted + oracle-source-verified): ctor/clear maxdepth=-1; exactly one buildADT across the three passes (maxdepth 1/2/4 per case, constant after pass 1); Ghidra cannot print the unlabeled-private field, so this leg is not part of the byte-compared stdout
coverage.persistent_globaldisjoint: MATCH (Rust-asserted + oracle-source-verified): the LocationMap cover (0/3/3 entries per case) survives every mem::take round-trip of the Heritage object
coverage.old_recipe_difference_record: RECORDED: the pre-refactor production recipe embedded ActionDeadCode between two direct passes; the canonical boundary leaves dead ops to the executor (pinned by unit test test_op_heritage_leaves_deadcode_to_the_action_executor); production switch is HERITAGE-DRIVER-SWITCH
coverage.phi_cycle_full_projection: MISMATCH (registered HERITAGE-ADT-RENAME-0001): on the phi self-reference cycle the oracle skips the already-heritaged (old-marker) register range while Rugra's place_multiequals still places a redundant parentless MULTIEQUAL + placeholder inputs; the op/vn projection is therefore not byte-compared for this case, only the no-hang witness and pass counter are
coverage.production_action_switch: UNTESTED: ActionHeritage::apply still runs the direct two-pass + DeadCode recipe; switching it to fd.op_heritage() is HERITAGE-DRIVER-SWITCH and depends on HERITAGE-CALLGUARD-0001 / HERITAGE-ADT-RENAME-0001
coverage.guardcalls_discovery_loadguards: UNTESTED (registered HERITAGE-CALLGUARD-0001): discoverIndexedStackPointers, guardCalls/guardReturns/guardStores/guardLoads canonical wiring, and reprocessFreeStores have no fixture case; the driver keeps the reprocess conditional wired with a zero counter
